product_metadata.title: Iso-Cool Side Sleeper Polyester Pillow with Outlast Cover
features: Made in the USA and Imported
300 thread count cotton cover; 100-percent polyester fill
3-inch gusseted pillow with Outlast Adaptive Comfort Technology offers a cooler night's sleep
Pillow features a zippered cover accented with piped edging and embroidered logo
Side Sleeper measures 17 x 23 x 3 inches
Made in the USA and Imported

description: The Iso-Cool polyester bed pillow has a 300 thread count, zippered cover with embroidery, corded edges, and Outlast Adaptive Comfort material for cooler sleeping. It is filled with luxurious RichLoft spiral spun polyester fiber and is completely adjustable for all sleeping positions. Cover is machine washable for easy care.
